observations.category_sum_note: The displayed rounded categories total 99.99B XRP, 0.01B below the 100B maximum. Preserve the rounding/unclassified residual; do not force-balance the categories.

limitations: XRP supply figures are rounded and explicitly dated October 28, 2026, not current November 19 balances.
The 5.23bn category is SBI's presentation label for Ripple holdings currently not in circulation; it should not be relabeled as exchange float or verified wallet balance.
The 31.4bn escrow quantity is a dated aggregate and does not by itself specify the timing or size of every future unlock.
Evernorth's 473m is rounded presentation data; exact closing reconciliation is in the SEC filing.

The displayed rounded categories total approximately 99.99B XRP, leaving an approximately 0.01B residual to the 100B maximum; do not force-balance or treat the residual as a verified burn or float category.

observations.cash_purchase_timing: Cash was received by October 23, 2025 and used to purchase 84,365,876 XRP; SEC filing says purchases were received by October 31 through November 6, 2025.
observations.gross_cash_proceeds_composition: Approximately $224.6M from private placement investments plus approximately $48.0M released from the SPAC trust account before transaction expenses.
observations.closing_reconciliation: 388,910,554 XRP contributed in kind plus 84,365,876 XRP purchased with pooled private-placement cash equals 473,276,430 XRP. The in-kind contribution includes subscription XRP and Ripple/Pathfinder contributions; it is not all new open-market buying.
observations.sbi_cash_attributed_to_total_purchase: SBI separately announced a $200M cash commitment to the PIPE. The SEC filing describes pooled investor cash; it does not attribute all 84,365,876 XRP purchases solely to SBI.

operating_results.q3_income_quality: Primarily affected by fair-value changes in refundable investor advances and digital-asset impairment; not operating revenue.

limitations: September 30 financial statements predate the October 9 business-combination closing; subsequent-event disclosures must be kept separate from quarter-end balances.
The $214.1M cash purchase pool is not proof that SBI alone funded or directed all purchases.
The closing 473.276M XRP total is not equivalent to 473.276M XRP of fresh spot-market demand because 388.911M was contributed in kind.
Evernorth had not generated revenue as of the filing; reported net income includes fair-value accounting effects.

observations.transaction: PIPE investment in Evernorth alongside Ripple and other investors
observations.stated_use: SBI said proceeds would be used primarily to purchase XRP on the open market and described institutional lending and DeFi as intended treasury strategies.

limitations: The announcement describes intended use and group commitment; the SEC filing's pooled-cash reconciliation is the stronger source for actual completed XRP purchases.
Do not treat the full $200M commitment as a verified direct spot purchase by SBI.

observations.coinbase_allocation_formula: Coinbase receives allocations based on USDC held on its platform after Circle issuer retention, plus half of the remaining broader ecosystem-growth amount after approved third-party ecosystem participants.
observations.economics_caveat: This is not 50% of gross Circle reserve income. It is an allocation within the contractual distribution-cost formula.
observations.rate_sensitivity: Circle states that reserve return rates affect reserve income, but the relationship between interest rates and USDC circulation is complex, highly uncertain and unproven.

circle_sbi_japan.status: No significant operating results to date as of September 30, 2026.

limitations: Q3 figures are issuer-reported financial measures, not XRP flows or XRP demand.
Distribution cost is not a direct proxy for Coinbase revenue, XRP purchases or transaction volume.
USDC supply and reserve-income changes are not automatically causal predictors of XRP price.

relationship_interpretation: SBI is simultaneously a major Evernorth cash investor and an investor/distributor in stablecoin infrastructure involving both Ripple and Circle; those are separate legal and economic relationships.
Ripple's XRP treasury/escrow position, Evernorth's holdings, SBI's cash commitment, and market spot purchases are separate capital categories.
Circle's USDC distribution economics with Coinbase are large and contractually material, but do not establish XRP demand.
SBI Group's Claude adoption is evidence of enterprise use of Anthropic products, not a tested Claude connection to Barrot.
Creator inventory remains conservative: one video-level guest match is supported; channel ownership and third-party uploads remain unverified.

prediction_admission.reason: Corporate disclosures and public market observations are context features only. They require point-in-time event coding, independent source groups, and chronological out-of-sample validation before forecast admission.

source_receipt_policy: Source-level claims are not model-admitted until exact raw bytes or stable source extracts are captured, hashed, time-stamped and anchored under the ingestion receipt policy.
